roadmap.title: Chapters 1-2: learn Leonida
roadmap.order: Start with Gone Fishing, then clear every mission in Chapter 1, then every mission in Chapter 2. Meditate at the first spot before Chapter 1 closes. Pick up the easy collectibles (vehicles, areas) while you travel.
plan: Play Gone Fishing, then every Chapter 1 mission in order.
Meditate at the first spot BEFORE the last Chapter 1 mission — it is gone after the chapter.
Clear Chapter 2 the same way, picking up vehicles and areas as you travel.
Start the counters early: stunts, WAiNK It spots, areas and vehicles.
roadmap.warning: MISSABLE: Positive Mental Attitude. The first meditation spot is gone once Chapter 1 ends, so meditate there before you finish the chapter.

roadmap.title: Chapters 3-4: strands and side content
roadmap.order: Clear Chapters 3 and 4 and their named missions, then play each stranger strand through to its last mission (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone). Between missions, work the activities: the shooting range, races, drone races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, hunting and meditation.
plan: Clear Chapters 3 and 4 and their named missions.
Play the five stranger strands to the end (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more for the silver.
Work the activities between missions: shooting range, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, hunting.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots; rob vaults, trucks and gang operations as they appear.
roadmap.warning: Nothing in this stage can be missed. Every strand can still be finished after the story, in free roam.

roadmap.title: Finale and cleanup: 100% and Platinum
roadmap.order: Finish the final mission, then work through the counters in this guide: stunts, WAiNK It spots, vehicles, areas, card sets, bank vaults, gangs, challenges and the two money totals. Check the in-game stats page for gaps, then reach 100% Completion for A Long Road. The Platinum pops with the last of the other 54.
plan: Finish the final mission for the gold, then stay in free roam.
Work the counters one at a time, checking the in-game stats page after each.
Sweep the last collectibles (cards, WAiNK It spots, areas) for the final percent.
Reach 100% Completion for A Long Road — the Platinum pops with the last of the other 54.
roadmap.warning: Nothing here can be missed. The counters are the long grind, so start them in stages 1 and 2 instead of saving them all for last.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum arrives on its own: the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, it pops. Follow the roadmap stages in order and keep the counters ticking as you play, so the last trophy is never a 40-hour grind.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first. The Platinum needs no separate task — it unlocks by itself the instant the last one lands.
Play the roadmap stages in order (1, then 2, then 3) rather than saving every grind for the end: the counters are the long tail, and starting them early saves hours.
Watch this guide's progress bar as your checklist: when it reads 54 of 55, the one row still unchecked is your last job.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, and the first trophy most players earn. Play Gone Fishing through to the end and the trophy pops when the mission closes.

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the first cutscene through to the mission-passed screen.
Follow the on-screen prompts for movement, driving and the fishing beats; no branch or fail state can lock this trophy out.
The trophy unlocks at the mission's end, before Chapter 1 properly begins.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops at the chapter's closing scene — but do the missable meditation first (see Positive Mental Attitude).

steps.text: Play Chapter 1's missions in the order the game offers them; the chapter tracker in the pause menu shows which are left.
Before the chapter's last mission, meditate at the first meditation spot: it disappears after Chapter 1, and it is the only missable step in the whole game.
Complete the final Chapter 1 mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter card.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops at the chapter's closing scene; side strands that open here can wait.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2's missions in the order the game offers them, including the story beats that open new parts of the map.
Side strands that open in Chapter 2 can wait: only the chapter missions are needed for this trophy.
Complete the final Chapter 2 mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter card.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 3. Two of its named missions also feed their own trophies, so each one ticks two rows at once.

steps.text: Play Chapter 3's missions in the order the game offers them; Vice City's districts open up as the chapter runs.
Named missions in this chapter also feed their own trophies (The Cartel Heist, Child's Play), so each one you finish ticks two rows at once.
Complete the final Chapter 3 mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter card.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops at the chapter's closing scene, just before the finale — three named missions here have their own trophies too.

steps.text: Play Chapter 4's missions in the order the game offers them; this is the last full chapter before the finale.
Named missions in this chapter also feed their own trophies (Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory).
Complete the final Chapter 4 mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter card.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: finish the game's final mission after Chapter 4. Free roam and cleanup stay open afterwards, so nothing is lost by finishing.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission; it appears as the next story beat on the map.
Play the final mission to its end. Stock up on ammo and armour first: it is the longest single mission in the game.
The gold trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen, and the game then drops you into free roam for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1. It is a driving mission — stay close to your partner and the leg restarts, not the mission, if you fall behind.

steps.text: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 1 story mission: follow the map marker when it appears after the opening missions.
Drive the route the mission sets and keep your partner close; falling too far behind restarts the leg, not the mission.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. The heist runs in phases — approach, vault, escape — and a failed phase restarts that phase only.

steps.text: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission: it unlocks once the chapter's earlier missions are done.
The heist runs in phases (approach, vault, escape): failing a phase restarts that phase, so take the escape slowly and keep a fast car ready.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 3. It is mostly on foot and up close — bring a short-range weapon and armour rather than a rifle.

steps.text: Child's Play is a Chapter 3 story mission: follow the map marker when it appears.
The mission is mostly on foot and up close, so bring a short-range weapon and armour rather than a rifle.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It mixes driving with a set-piece finish — keep a sturdy car and a full armour bar for the last stretch.

steps.text: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission: follow the map marker when it appears after the chapter's earlier missions.
The mission mixes driving with a set-piece finish; keep a sturdy car and a full armour bar for the last stretch.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, at the Vice City airport. The airport is heavily guarded — move between the parked aircraft instead of crossing open tarmac.

steps.text: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission at Vice City International Airport: follow the map marker when it appears.
The airport is heavily guarded, so use cover and move between the parked aircraft rather than crossing the open tarmac.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4. It is combat-heavy with a long final push — bring a rifle, plenty of ammo and snacks for health.

steps.text: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 4 story mission: follow the map marker when it appears after Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
The mission is combat-heavy with a long final push; bring a rifle, plenty of ammo and snacks for health.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold completion trophy: reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist. It is the last big job before the Platinum — the final percent is almost always collectibles.

steps.text: 100% Completion counts the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities together; the in-game stats page shows the percentage and what is still missing.
Clear the story and the strands first, then work the counters in this guide one at a time, checking the stats page after each one.
The last few percent are almost always collectibles (cards, WAiNK It spots, areas), so leave a sweep of those for the end.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats. The counter in this guide tracks them; PlayStation tracks the same count, and the game's stats page shows the running total.

steps.text: A stunt is any driving feat the game flashes on screen: big jumps, near misses in traffic, long airtime and clean landings. Each flash counts once toward the 250.

Farm them on the highways: weave through traffic for near misses, then hit the stunt jumps and ramps dotted around Leonida and repeat the loop. One highway loop yields a dozen stunts in a few minutes.
The game's stats page shows the running total; tick this guide's counter up as you go so you always know how many are left.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: the shooting range, races, drone races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the stranger strands' activities. One try each is enough — no score or win is needed.

steps.text: The 9 activity types are the ones this guide tags as activities; trying one of each is the whole requirement, and no score or win is needed.
Work through the activity trophies in this guide: every one you start ticks a type off, so the trophy lands while you chase the others.
If it has not popped, check which activity rows are still unchecked here and try the missing one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several challenges, and each one needs its gold score — accuracy beats speed.

steps.text: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges in Leonida; each one lists its gold-medal score before you start it.
Gold scores reward accuracy over speed: aim for headshots and controlled bursts, and restart a challenge the moment a run goes bad.
Work range by range and tick this guide's counter after each gold, so you can see which ranges still have challenges left.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. One win per location; the race can be retried as often as you like.

steps.text: Top Fun drone races are marked at 14 locations across Leonida; each location needs one win, not a best time.
Fly the racing line: cut the gates tight, use the boost pads, and brake before the sharp turns instead of overshooting them.
Tick this guide's counter after each location's win; the in-game activity menu shows which locations you have already won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count: it has to be 20 distinct events — any type counts (street, off-road, boat, air).

steps.text: Any race type counts (street, off-road, boat, air), but each event only counts the first time you win it.
Work through the race list on the map instead of replaying favourites: the list shows which events you have already won.
Tick this guide's counter after each new win; at 20, the trophy pops on the results screen.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his challenge, and out-fish him — bigger and rarer fish beat more small ones.

steps.text: Cal offers fishing challenges once you have met him and unlocked fishing; his challenge marker appears at the fishing spots.
A fishing challenge is scored on the catch: bigger and rarer fish beat more small ones, so use the best bait and tackle you can buy.
If you lose, the challenge can be retried at once from the same spot; the trophy pops on the win screen.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Any cabinet and any of its games count — pick a quick one first.

steps.text: Arcade cabinets stand in bars and arcades around Leonida; walk up to one and start a game.
Any cabinet and any of its games count, and you need to reach the game's end, not just start it.
The trophy pops at the game's completion screen; the easiest cabinets are the short ones, so pick a quick game first.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's strand of side missions to the end and complete his final mission. The missions are short and mostly driving and fetch work — quick between story missions.

steps.text: Andy's strand opens when you meet him in the open world; his missions appear one at a time, each unlocking the next.
Play the strand in order; the missions are short and mostly driving and fetch work, so they are quick between story missions.
Complete Andy's final mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand of side missions to the end and complete his final mission. The strand leans on boats and the water — keep a fast boat handy near the coast.

steps.text: Kenton's strand opens when you meet him; his missions appear one at a time, each unlocking the next.
The strand leans on boats and the water, so keep a fast boat handy near the coast between missions.
Complete Kenton's final mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand of side missions to the end and complete his final mission. The strand is built around bikes — keep a fast motorcycle ready for the long cross-state rides.

steps.text: Billy's strand opens when you meet him; his missions appear one at a time, each unlocking the next.
The strand is built around bikes, so keep a fast motorcycle ready and expect long cross-state rides.
Complete Billy's final mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight — any three more count.

steps.text: There are more than 8 stranger strands in Leonida, and any 8 completed strands count; the five named ones in this guide are a head start.
Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions that ends with its own trophy.
Tick this guide's counter after each strand you finish; at 8, the silver trophy pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand of side missions to the end and complete his final mission. The strand is supply runs and deliveries — keep a van or truck ready and expect timed driving.

steps.text: Randy's strand opens when you meet him; his missions appear one at a time, each unlocking the next.
The strand is supply runs and deliveries, so keep a van or truck ready and expect timed driving.
Complete Randy's final mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's strand of side missions to the end and complete his final mission. The strand mixes driving and on-foot work around Vice City — keep a car nearby and armour in your pocket.

steps.text: Tyrone's strand opens when you meet him; his missions appear one at a time, each unlocking the next.
The strand mixes driving and on-foot work around Vice City, so keep a car nearby and armour in your pocket.
Complete Tyrone's final mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-passed screen.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The first meditation spot disappears after Chapter 1. Meditate there before you finish Chapter 1, or the trophy is locked for this playthrough.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first spot is gone after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends. The other 17 stay open all game.

steps.text: MISSABLE: the first meditation spot sits in the Chapter 1 area and disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Meditate there before the chapter's final mission — this is the single step in the whole game that cannot be done later.
The other 17 spots stay open for the whole game: beaches, hilltops, parks and quiet corners, marked on the map once you have found one. Sweep them district by district in free roam.
Sit and meditate at each spot; tick this guide's counter after each one, and at 18 the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Meet Bret, take the hunt, track the animal with the hunting clues in its region and bring it down with a clean shot.

steps.text: Meet Bret to start the hunt; he names the unique animal and the region it roams in.
Track it with the hunting clues in that region (tracks, calls, feeding signs) rather than wandering blind.
Bring the animal down with a clean shot and the trophy pops when the hunt ends.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and each set needs every card in it — work set by set, not at random.

steps.text: Collectible cards are tucked into shops, landmarks and hideouts across Leonida; each card belongs to one set, and a set counts only when it is full.
Work set by set instead of grabbing cards at random: the collection menu shows which cards each set is still missing.
Tick this guide's counter after each full set; at 3 sets, the silver trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Each landmark or viewpoint only counts once, so you need 100 distinct spots — sweep district by district.

steps.text: WAiNK It is the in-game check-in at landmarks and viewpoints: open it at a marked spot and it logs the location.
Only distinct locations count, so sweep the map district by district instead of revisiting the same viewpoints.
Tick this guide's counter after each new location; at 100, the silver trophy pops.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. They are small tasks that stack up as you play — pick the easy ones first.

steps.text: Challenges are the game's own checklist of small tasks (driving, combat, exploration, activities); the challenge menu shows them all and your progress on each.
Pick the easy ones first: many complete themselves while you play the story and the other trophies.
Tick this guide's counter as you clear them; at 50, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trophy pops the moment the wanted level clears while your partner is still with you.

steps.text: Bring your partner along (story missions and free-roam partner moments both work), then raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight, then hide in an alley, a parking garage or the countryside until the stars start to blink and fade.
The trophy pops the moment the wanted level clears while your partner is still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level between them. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over — pick three shops close together.

steps.text: Bring your partner, then rob a shop: aim at the clerk and take the till, and keep the wanted level you earn.
Drive straight to the next shop and rob it while the stars are still up, then a third: the chain breaks if the wanted level clears at any point.
Pick three shops close together on a quiet street and use a fast car between them; the trophy pops after the third till.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a vehicle you have never driven logs it; variety is what counts — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and planes all count.

steps.text: A vehicle counts the first time you get into it, so drive anything new you see: cars, bikes, trucks, boats and planes all count.
Sweep car parks, dealerships, docks and the airport for types you have not driven yet; rare spawns hide in specific districts.
Tick this guide's counter for each new discovery; at 100, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group them first, then trigger it and drop all five before it ends — busy gang shootouts are the best spot.

steps.text: Combat Focus slows time for a short window; it is one use, so all 5 takedowns must happen inside that single window.
Lure or wait for a group of 5 enemies to bunch up, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them with headshots.
Busy gang shootouts and police chases are the best spots: the enemies come to you in groups. This guide's counter tracks your best run.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: leave the airport in a plane or vehicle that was never scheduled to leave.

steps.text: Go to VCIA, the airport in Vice City; the runways and hangars are the departure side of the trick.
Take a parked plane (or any aircraft on the field) and get it airborne, or drive a vehicle out through the airside gates: the point is leaving without a ticket or a flight.
The trophy pops once you are clear of the airport grounds in your unscheduled ride.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos, the tanks. Get one moving under your control — steal one when its crew is out of it — and the trophy pops.

steps.text: Rhinos are the military tanks that roll out at high wanted levels and around the base; the trophy is about getting into one, not just seeing one.
Steal a Rhino when its crew is out of it, or climb in during a chase when it stops: drive it a short way and the trophy registers.
Expect a heavy police response, so take the tank somewhere open and be ready to bail out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: in and out with the goods, no alarm, no witness, no wanted level. Case the store first — cameras, sightlines, exits.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and case it first: note the cameras, the clerk's sightlines and the exits.
Move quietly, take the goods without smashing glass in sight of the clerk, and slip out before anyone raises the alarm.
The trophy pops when you leave the area clean; if an alarm trips or a star appears, the attempt is over and you retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five vaults, five clean getaways — a failed escape does not count the vault.

steps.text: Bank vaults are the big robbery targets in Vice City and the towns; each one is a planned job, not a smash-and-grab.
Crack the vault, take the cash and escape the wanted level before the next one: a failed escape does not count the vault.
Tick this guide's counter after each escaped vault; at 5, the silver trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop it, crack it, take the cash and lose the cops — the trophy pops once your wanted level clears.

steps.text: Armored trucks run set routes around Vice City and the highways; the map and the traffic give away where they are.
Stop the truck (ram it or block it), crack the rear doors, take the cash, then break away before the police box you in.
The trophy pops once your wanted level clears after the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named district, town and stretch of countryside counts — the map shades each one in as you enter it.

steps.text: Leonida has 52 named areas; the map shades each one in as you enter it, and the stats page keeps the running count.
Drive the state border to border, detouring into every town and district; the last few are usually the small rural areas, not the cities.
Tick this guide's counter per area; at 52, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang, nine in total — the same gang twice does not count.

steps.text: Leonida has 9 gangs, each running illegal operations (stash houses, labs, fronts) in its own turf.
Hit one operation per gang and get clear: the same gang twice does not count, so move on to the next gang's turf.
Tick this guide's counter per gang; at 9, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this trophy yet. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so that is the best lead, honestly labelled as unproven.

steps.text: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of Nov 2026 no published guide lists a verified unlock method for this trophy.
Best lead from the official description: order a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and sit with the sea view; try the bars along the beachfront in the evening.
If it does not pop, do not grind it blind: wait for a confirmed guide, and check this guide's sources panel for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this trophy yet. The description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom, so that is the best lead, honestly labelled as unproven.

steps.text: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of Nov 2026 no published guide lists a verified unlock method for this trophy.
Best lead from the official description: take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the glass front, in the classic style.
If it does not pop, try another showroom or a faster car through the front; if it still does not pop, wait for a confirmed guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, and follow through on your throw. The trophy is about playing it properly, not about the score — a strike is not required.

steps.text: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is the bowling venue in Vice City; walk in and start a game at a lane.
Bowl a full game and follow through on the throws: the trophy is about playing it properly, not about the score.
The trophy pops at the end of the game; a strike is not required.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal: play the partner activities together until the partnership moment lands. Keep doing things together between story missions rather than playing solo for long stretches.

steps.text: Partner activities (driving, hanging out, shared jobs) build the partnership over time; the trophy is about the partnership, not one event.
Keep doing things together between story missions rather than playing solo for long stretches.
The trophy pops at a scripted partnership moment once the bond is high enough; if it has not landed, do more partner activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. PlayStation tracks a count to 500: story choices, side choices and activity choices all feed it — play naturally and it climbs on its own.

steps.text: Every choice you make feeds the count: story decisions, stranger-strand choices and activity choices alike.
Play naturally and the count climbs on its own; the fastest feed is the side strands and the repeatable activities, which keep offering choices.
Tick this guide's counter in batches as the stats page total rises; at 500, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this trophy yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second try, so that is the best lead, honestly labelled as unproven.

steps.text: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of Nov 2026 no published guide lists a verified unlock method for this trophy.
Best lead from the official description: fail an attempt at something, then succeed at the same thing on the very next try.
Likely candidates are a race, a challenge or a mission leg; try failing once on purpose, then winning the retry, and if it does not pop, wait for a confirmed guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this trophy yet. The description hints at witnessing something strange, so that is the best lead, honestly labelled as unproven.

steps.text: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of Nov 2026 no published guide lists a verified unlock method for this trophy.
Best lead from the official description: witness a strange event somewhere in Leonida, the kind of odd encounter the game hides off the main path.
Sweep the odd corners of the map at night (the swamps, the desert roads, the empty beaches) and watch for anything out of place; if nothing pops, wait for a confirmed guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this trophy yet. The description hints at knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, so that is the best lead, honestly labelled as unproven.

steps.text: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of Nov 2026 no published guide lists a verified unlock method for this trophy.
Best lead from the official description: swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian from a slow-moving vehicle, bowling them over in a drive-by.
Try it from a car at low speed on a quiet street; if it does not pop, try a bike or a different melee weapon, and if it still does not pop, wait for a confirmed guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; your contacts wash them into clean cash — convert them in batches.

steps.text: Marked Bills pile up from heists, vault robberies and armored trucks; they are worthless until laundered, so keep doing the big jobs.
Take the bills to your laundering contacts and convert them in batches; each batch adds to the $250,000 total.
Tick this guide's counter per batch (in dollars); at $250,000 laundered, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts: clothes, weapons, cars, food. Big purchases move the total fastest — buy the expensive things you want anyway.

steps.text: Every dollar spent in any shop counts toward the $100,000, from snacks to supercars.
Buy the expensive things you want anyway (weapons, cars, clothes) and the total climbs without wasting money.
Tick this guide's counter per purchase (in dollars); at $100,000 spent, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. They go on sale as you progress, and each one is a place to store your vehicles — the story and the heists pay enough that you will not need to grind cash just for these.

steps.text: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, marked on the map with the property sign once they are available.
Buy them as the money comes in: the story and the heists pay enough that you will not need to grind cash just for these.
Tick this guide's counter per garage; at 8 owned, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — each one only counts the first time.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone; it lists the vehicles you can register.
Register any 10 vehicles: cars, bikes and the rest all count, and each one only counts the first time.
Tick this guide's counter per registration; at 10, the trophy pops.
